title: Bug fix
description: Locate the root cause, gate on the fix plan, implement, review the diff, validate and deploy the changed files.

inputs.label: Run local Apex tests during validation
Deploy to the default org at the end
Visual test before deploy (opens the org in the browser with your LOCAL UI files + live org data)

steps.title: Locate root cause (agent, read-only)
steps.prompt:
You are investigating a bug. DO NOT modify any files in this step.
Bug report: {inputs.description}
Find the root cause in the local codebase. Reply with: (1) the root cause, (2) the exact files involved, (3) a concrete fix plan. Keep it short.
End your reply with one line listing every involved file as project-relative paths:
FILES: force-app/main/default/classes/Example.cls, force-app/main/default/classes/ExampleTest.cls

steps.title: Approve fix plan
steps.message: Review the root-cause analysis and fix plan above. Proceed with implementing it?

steps.title: Retrieve fresh copies of affected files from the org
Compare retrieved files against the investigated versions
Re-analyse fresh code if needed, then implement fix (agent)
Code review of the changes (agent, read-only)
steps.prompt:
Review ONLY the changes listed below (made in this run) against the team standards. Do not modify any files.
Changed files:
{steps.changes.output}
Deterministic standards-check result:
{steps.verify-standards.output}
Read each changed file, review the actual change, and end with exactly one line:
VERDICT: READY — or — VERDICT: BLOCKED, followed by the numbered blocking items.

steps.title: Approve code changes
steps.message: The files listed above were changed. Open the diffs from the run view; type instructions and Revise to have the fix reworked. Approve to validate against the org.

steps.title: Visual test — local files against live org data (Local Dev)
Approve deploy
steps.message: Validation passed. If you enabled the visual test, click through the app in the browser first. Deploy the changed files to the default org now?
